paragraph: [Africell Angola's cheapest 30-day prepaid plan of 5 GB or more is 7 GB for 5,000 kwanza, on its tariff page as at 23 October 2025](<https://www.africell.ao/afrinet/>). At that price 5 GB for a month comes to 1.89 per cent of average monthly income, on the World Bank's income figure for 2025. The International Telecommunication Union's price figures [put the cost at 3.91 per cent in 2024 and 3.05 per cent in 2025](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Statistics/Pages/ICTprices/default.aspx>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No figure of 1 per cent or less has been found. Mature would need a month of data to cost 1 per cent or less of average monthly income.

The same figures [gave 25.24 per cent in 2022, 24.93 per cent in 2023 and 20.66 per cent in 2024](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Statistics/Pages/ICTprices/default.aspx>). No change to these figures has been found in the last twelve months. [ABUCO said on 28 July 2026 that the cost of mega bundles has in some cases doubled or tripled since 2025](<https://www.sosmediasburundi.org/2026/07/31/telecoms-en-crise-au-burundi-labuco-denonce-linaction-des-autorites-face-a-la-degradation-des-services/>). It gave no resulting price. Preparing would need a month of 5 GB to cost 10 per cent of average monthly income or less, on a figure for 2024 or later.

[In August 2026 the monthly 5,000 CFA franc bundles of MTN, Moov Africa and Celtiis gave over 11 GB](<https://lamarina.bj/2026/08/06/hausse-des-tarifs-data-au-benin-la-reponse-de-larcep-qui-pose-encore-question/>), La Marina reported. At that price a month of data comes to 6.29 per cent of average monthly income, on the World Bank's income figure for 2025. In the last twelve months this August 2026 figure has stood below [the 6.89 per cent that the International Telecommunication Union gave for 2025](<https://www.itu.int/en/ITU-D/Statistics/Pages/ICTprices/default.aspx>). No figure of 5 per cent or less has been found. Establishing would need the cost to be 5 per cent or less of average monthly income.
